answers.diagnosed_scope: runtime matching mismatch on a fixed pattern bank; not direct evidence that re-mining the bank with a new objective would improve inference.
answers.k_layout: [B,H,T,D], quantized after transpose to [B,H,D,T] in 128-token groups
answers.range_regret_runtime_formula: For V sample records only, stored value is minmax_mse - oracle_mse; it is not the frozen normalized range-regret formula.
answers.runtime_l2_assignment: batched_assign_compiled for mined K/V centroids during prefill initialization

findings.interpretation: Pattern bank mining uses L2 KMeans updates on a fixed [H,N,D] token matrix.

findings.evidence: assign_k = batched_assign_compiled(Xk, k_centroids); assign = batched_assign_compiled(X, centroids).
findings.interpretation: Runtime prefill assignment for both K and V uses L2 nearest-centroid assignment on the mined bank.
K min-max assignment is defined on residual dynamic range over the head_dim axis for each [H,N,D] token vector.
V runtime nearest-centroid matching uses min-max residual range over head_dim, not L2.

findings.evidence: K is transposed on [B,H,T,D] -> [B,H,D,T] and quantized along the last dimension in 128-token groups.
findings.interpretation: Real K quantization axis is per-channel over 128-token groups, so K range-aware evidence must respect token grouping after transpose.

findings.evidence: V stays [B,H,T,D] and is quantized along the last dimension.
findings.interpretation: Real V quantization axis is per-token over head_dim=128.

findings.evidence: l2_assignment and minmax_assignment are sampled per token within a 128-token K group.
findings.interpretation: Existing K oracle records diagnose runtime matching mismatch on a fixed pattern bank, not a re-mined bank objective.

findings.evidence: raw_group_mse, current_group_mse, minmax_group_mse, conditional_oracle_group_mse are stored; no residual ranges are stored.
findings.interpretation: K oracle records provide MSE-gap evidence but do not directly expose K range regret or per-assignment residual ranges.

findings.evidence: l2_assignment, minmax_assignment, l2_minmax_mismatch, range_regret, current_oracle_gap, minmax_oracle_gap are recorded.
findings.interpretation: V oracle records directly contain mismatch and a regret-like scalar, but only at sampled-token granularity.

findings.evidence: matching_oracle_gap.csv keeps only metrics whose names contain oracle_gap.
findings.interpretation: Published matching_oracle_gap.csv does not export mismatch counts or range regret directly.

findings.evidence: When max_sample_records is reached, dropped_record_count increments and later records are discarded.
findings.interpretation: Any recoverability path that depends on sample records is invalid for fully recovered 140-sample conclusions when truncation is present.
